items.title: 18.4 Predicting Formula and Charge of a Complex Ion

source_refs.note: Topic 18.4 with Table 18.3, printed page 21, checked against the page image.

blocks.text: The formula and charge of a complex ion are determined by combining the central metal ion, its oxidation state, and the ligands along with their charges. The general structure of a complex ion is [M(L)ₓ]±ʸ. Where, M is the central metal ion, L is the ligand, x is the number of ligand (determined by the coordination number) and ±y is the overall charge of the complex ion.

Explanation of charge calculation of complex
Metal charge (+3) + (Number of ligands × Ligand charge). A positive sum.
Metal charge (+2) + (Number of ligands × Ligand charge). A negative sum.
Metal charge (0) + (Number of ligands × Ligand charge). A zero sum.
